item.title: Suspect returns to Pilsen nail salon to retrieve phone left during robbery
item.description: The owners of a Pilsen nail salon are speaking out after being robbed on Saturday. They say one of the suspects even broke down their glass door after realizing he left his phone behind.

item.title: Kankakee County opens one-stop recovery center after devastating tornado
item.description: The center opened Monday at Aroma Park's United Methodist Church as a one-stop shop for residents' recovery needs.

item.title: Is Trump considering a military draft for Iran?
item.description: A draft hasn’t been instituted in the country since 1973, and enlisting in the service is voluntary.

item.title: Student involved in prank linked to Georgia teacher’s death thanks his widow for forgiveness
item.description: Jayden Wallace, the teenager who was formerly accused of vehicular homicide in the death of Georgia teacher Jason Hughes, has thanked Hughes’ widow for her compassion in the days following the tragic accident.

item.title: 795-acre proposed data center to take center stage at Joliet City Council meeting
item.description: The Joliet City Council is set to vote on a proposed 795-acre Artificial Intelligence data center, which would consume 1.8 gigawatts of electricity annually, despite concerns over water usage, noise pollution, and traffic.

item.title: FAA proposes deeper cuts to O'Hare flights to ease congestion
item.description: The FAA has proposed deeper cuts to O'Hare International Airport's summer schedule in order to ease congestion and improve the on-time experience for passengers.

item.title: Tuesday: Coldest St. Patrick's Day in nearly six decades
item.description: All indications suggest that this will be the coldest St. Patrick’s Day in at least 59 years.

item.title: Chicago firefighter seriously injured while battling Far North Side fire
item.description: A Chicago firefighter was seriously injured while battling a fire in the Rogers Park neighborhood on Monday.
